programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programmes.d: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programmes.d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
programmes.d: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box
programmes.d: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Masks
programmes.d: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programmes.d: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences
programmes.d: A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
programmes.d: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room
programmes.d: Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programmes.d: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves
programmes.d: Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

programmes.t: The Neon Demon
programmes.d: Den purunge kvinde, Jesse (Elle Fanning), flytter til Los Angeles for at forsøge at skabe sig en karriere som fotomodel. Her spottes hun af en af byens førende modelagenter og efter en prøvefotografering bliver hun hurtigt talk of town,

programmes.t: Scream 4
programmes.d: Sidney vender tilbage til Woodsboro som en succesfuld forfatter og er i byen for at promovere sin nye selvhjælpsbog. Men den frygtede Ghostface-killer viser sig igen, og det lader til, at den eneste, han har ventet på i alle disse år, er Sidney.

programmes.t: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programmes.d: Steven er dygtig hjertekirurg og gift med Anna, der er respekteret øjenlæge. De lever lykkeligt med deres to børn. Steven er ven med den 16-årige Martin, som er forældreløs. Tingene tager en mørk drejning, da Steven introducerer Martin for familien.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Something in the Walls
programmes.d: A doctor arrives at his new job in a sanitarium. He discovers the case of a woman who is terribly frightened of things that appear on her walls.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Room 2426
programmes.d: Martin Decker is confined to a special room for acts and thoughts against the state. They want the formula for a weapon he does not want to reveal. Escape for Martin comes from the mind.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Mind of Simon Foster
programmes.d: In an impoverished future, Simon Foster goes to a pawnshop to sell some personal items to raise money for rent. The shop owner offers to buy some of his memories. In Simon Foster's life, what could be possibly be valuable?

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Wall
programmes.d: A U.S. military experiment opens a portal to an unknown place. After sending through one team, the Army calls upon a career soldier to investigate, where he finds an idyllic planet. He has to decide whether to stay or go back to his old life.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Cat and Mouse
programmes.d: A shy woman finds that a cat is actually a cursed "Casanova." She falls for the man but finds that her Prince Charming is actually a scoundrel.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Rendezvous in a Dark Place
programmes.d: An old woman with an obsession with death attends funerals for entertainment. One night when an injured thief breaks into her home, she lets him die and waits for Death to come and collect him.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Many, Many Monkeys
programmes.d: An epidemic breaks out and many people are struck blind. Something more happens, however: People have become cold and heartless toward each other

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Love Is Blind
programmes.d: A man plotting to murder his wife's lover meets a blind singer who seems to know all about his plans.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
programmes.d: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programmes.d: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
programmes.d: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programmes.d: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
programmes.d: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
programmes.d: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Lonely
programmes.d: Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programmes.d: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Perchance to Dream
programmes.d: A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Judgment Night
programmes.d: In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programmes.d: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What You Need
programmes.d: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Four of Us are Dying
programmes.d: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Third From the Sun
programmes.d: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programmes.d: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.
